story.title: ZuckOff Know when a camera is in the room

draft:
Imagine your laptop silently telling you when a webcam is watching.

I just tried ZuckOff, a lightweight app that pings you the moment a camera becomes active in the room. It hooks into the OS‑level device APIs, so even hidden or software‑enabled cameras trigger an alert. The UI is minimal—just a discreet icon and a push notification—yet the impact feels immediate.

What this shows is a shift from passive consent to active awareness. In a world where video calls are the norm, we’re often oblivious to who’s listening. Tools like ZuckOff force a conversation about consent and could push manufacturers to build hardware‑level shutters as a default.

Do you think we’ll see more “privacy‑first” utilities become a standard part of our daily workflow?  

#Privacy #AI #Surveillance #Webcam #TechEthics
